entries.name: MYS C01 Protagonist
entries.description: Hungarian / Central-European man, apparent age about 38–42, average height, lean-to-average build, physically ordinary. Intelligent restrained face, observant brown/hazel eyes, slight natural fatigue, short medium-to-dark brown hair, natural hairline, very light stubble, fair/light Central-European complexion.

entries.name: MYS C02 Soho Woman
entries.description: Fictional European woman, apparent age about 32–38, average-to-slim natural build, warm intelligent eyes, distinctive but ordinary believable face, natural medium-brown or dark-blonde shoulder-length hair, light natural makeup, realistic skin texture. Capable of a small spontaneous human smile that matters emotionally without looking theatrical.

entries.name: MYS C03 Policewoman
entries.description: Fictional British/European woman, apparent age about 35–45, average height, fit but ordinary professional build, serious practical face, intelligent eyes, natural brown/dark-blonde hair secured simply, minimal makeup, realistic skin. She must look like an ordinary working police officer, calm and procedural rather than aggressive; never an action-film or villain archetype.

entries.name: MYS C04 Appointed Lawyer
entries.description: Fictional British/European man, apparent age about 45–55, average height and ordinary professional build, intelligent slightly tired face, short dark or greying brown hair, natural age lines, calm restrained professional presence. Not a television-lawyer archetype, not sinister, not glamorous.

entries.name: MYS C05 Final Nurse
entries.description: Fictional European woman, apparent age about 38–48, average height and ordinary natural build, kind competent grounded face, calm eyes, medium-brown or dark-blonde hair secured simply, minimal makeup, realistic skin. She must look completely normal, friendly and non-sinister.

entries.name: MYS C06 Shared-House Substitute / Snoring Housemate
entries.description: Fictional Hungarian / Central-European man, apparent age about 28–38, average height and ordinary build, practical slightly worn appearance, short brown hair, natural face, no glamour. He represents the replacement housemate whose arrival is first registered by a different snore; he must look like an ordinary migrant worker / young professional rather than a comic character.

entries.name: MYS C07 Fx-Mortgage Housemate
entries.description: Fictional Hungarian / Central-European man, apparent age about 32–42, average build, grounded responsible face with visible everyday pressure rather than misery. He is the London housemate whose spouse, child and foreign-currency mortgage obligations remain connected to Hungary.

entries.name: MYS C08 Fx-Mortgage Spouse
entries.description: Fictional Hungarian / Central-European woman, apparent age about 30–40, ordinary natural build, calm intelligent face, practical everyday appearance. She represents the spouse remaining in Hungary within the foreign-currency-mortgage family memory.

entries.name: MYS C09 Fx-Mortgage Child
entries.description: Fictional Hungarian child, apparent age about 6–9, ordinary healthy build, natural face and age-appropriate proportions. This is a fictionalized visual identity for the family-memory child and must not resemble any real participant.

entries.name: MYS C10 Beginner-Dance Woman
entries.description: Fictional European woman, apparent age about 30–40, average natural build, approachable ordinary face, expressive eyes, practical hairstyle. She is a recurring visual anchor for the beginner dance-floor memory and must feel like a real participant in a social class rather than a professional dancer or romantic fantasy.

entries.name: MYS C11 Russian Transit Passenger
entries.description: Fictional local Russian adult man, apparent age about 35–55, ordinary commuter build and believable everyday face. He is the passenger who calmly uses his monthly transit pass to help the protagonist through a gate.

entries.name: MYS C12 Agra Bus Woman
entries.description: Fictional Indian woman, apparent age about 28–45, ordinary natural build, grounded intelligent face and practical everyday appearance. She is the woman whose voice/conversation is remembered from behind or across a bus seat in the Agra travel memory.

entries.name: MYS C13 Sudanese Traveler — Man
entries.description: Fictional Sudanese adult man, apparent age about 30–45, average natural build, grounded ordinary face, calm attentive presence. He is one half of the Sudanese couple sharing the Cairo taxi memory.

entries.name: MYS C14 Sudanese Traveler — Woman
entries.description: Fictional Sudanese adult woman, apparent age about 28–42, average natural build, grounded ordinary face, calm observant presence. She is the other half of the Sudanese couple sharing the Cairo taxi memory.

entries.name: MYS C15 Cairo Taxi Driver
entries.description: Fictional Egyptian man, apparent age about 35–55, ordinary working-driver build, weathered but natural face, alert eyes, grounded practical presence. He is the taxi driver within the Cairo travel memory and must feel like a real working person, not a comic or threatening archetype.

entries.name: MYS C16 Balloon Local Helper — Man
entries.description: Fictional local adult man, apparent age about 30–55, ordinary rural/edge-of-town build, natural weathered face and practical demeanor. He is one of the people who helps after the hot-air-balloon lands in a vegetable plot.

entries.name: MYS C17 Balloon Local Helper — Woman
entries.description: Fictional local adult woman, apparent age about 30–55, ordinary natural build, grounded practical face and calm strength. She is another recurring helper in the vegetable-plot balloon landing memory.
